image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a floral porcelain teacup resting on a matching saucer. The cup features a white base with pink roses, blue flowers, and green leaves, accented by gold rims on the lip and foot. It has a classic C-shaped handle. The background is a textured pink fabric.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific sub-classification of the object as a teacup/cup and verify material properties visually.
To ensure the handle is topologically connected to the body and the rim is a closed loop without AI-generation breaks or floating pixels.
To detect subtle texture smearing in the complex floral design or inconsistencies in the reflective gold trim.
To verify correct spatial grounding between the cup and the saucer, ensuring no impossible intersections or shadow errors.

focus_areas: Handle attachment points for structural integrity
Continuity of the gold rim for geometric consistency
Texture sharpness of the floral decal vs. background blur
Contact shadows between cup base and saucer
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the floral pattern and the white porcelain; AI often blurs these boundaries. Verify that the gold trim maintains consistent thickness and reflectivity around the curved surfaces.
